text:
Our review of “Image Transformation Folder” found 1 likely cause of the problems in Frontify. The recommended changes are below.

1. Item is flipped or skewed
Frontify can’t reproduce flipped or skewed items, so they’ll look different or break when edited.
Where: the image “logo_KawaksakiMotorsCorp.USA_original.png” (pages 1–2)
• Select the image frame and choose Object > Transform > Clear Transformations (or set the shear angle to 0° and remove the flip).
Learn more

Once that’s done, package the document again with File > Package, zip the package folder and upload it to Frontify.
